translations.web: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.
translations.bsb: Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on her.
translations.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand
translations.asv: But the vow of a widow, or of her that is divorced, even everything wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand against her.
